headline: W.P. Carey's Q2 AFFO Beats Estimates on Investment Activity
summary: WPC tops Q2 AFFO estimates as investment activity and rent growth lift revenues. The company raises its 2026 AFFO guidance and investment outlook.

headline: BXP Q2 FFO & Revenues Beat Estimates on Occupancy Gains, '26 View Up
